contentFull:
Ecorobotix adds potato model and targets yellow nutsedge with AI spot spraying

 30-10 | Smart farming | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Yellow nutsedge in a cabbage field. Photo: Ecorobotix

Swiss manufacturer Ecorobotix is expanding its ARA precision sprayer with 10 new commercial plant-detection models from March 2027, including potatoes, garlic and leeks. Another 55 models will become available for free testing, including one targeting yellow nutsedge. According to Ecorobotix, field trials of the newly commercialised models achieved an average 86% reduction in spray inputs compared with broadcast spraying.

The additions bring Ecorobotix’s portfolio to more than 120 plant-recognition and treatment models. The manufacturer says the models moving into commercial use were tested on more than 11,000 hectares (27,180 acres) across over 20 countries during 2026. The reported 86% input reduction is an average across these trials. Ecorobotix has not published separate results for each crop model.

Yellow nutsedge detection under development

One of the most notable additions is a detection model for yellow nutsedge (Cyperus esculentus), an invasive weed that spreads through underground tubers and is particularly difficult to control.

According to Ecorobotix, the new algorithm can identify yellow nutsedge among crop plants and target it with a non-selective herbicide without damaging the surrounding crop. “With the development of this new algorithm, we are offering the first precision spraying solution capable of detecting yellow nutsedge and applying a non-selective herbicide directly to the weed without damaging the crop,” says Simon Gasser, Agronomist and Crop Algorithm Product Manager at Ecorobotix. The model will become available to ARA users for free testing in March 2027. Its effectiveness and crop selectivity under different field conditions have yet to be demonstrated in published comparative results.

Potato model commercially available in 2027

Ecorobotix is also introducing a commercial detection model for potatoes. During development, the company compared weed-control efficacy using ARA with conventional broadcast spraying in Swiss field trials. According to the manufacturer, the system successfully controlled common weeds in potatoes, with results assessed 20 days after treatment. Detailed comparative efficacy figures were not included in the announcement. Belgian potato grower Luc Détroz reportedly used the model across 300 hectares (741 acres). “This clearly saved the crop. In a single pass, we were able to control goosefoot and knotweed, and the field remained weed-free until the end,” Détroz says.

More than 1,000 ARA sprayers in use

Ecorobotix reports that more than 1,000 ARA sprayers are now operating worldwide, with a cumulative treated area exceeding 600,000 hectares (1.48 million acres). The manufacturer also reports that the area treated using its existing carrot model increased by more than 80%, as growers seek alternatives following restrictions on metribuzin. For growers, the expanding software portfolio could make existing ARA sprayers suitable for additional crops and weed species without requiring a new machine. However, the availability of a detection model does not automatically permit the use of every herbicide. Local product authorisations and application restrictions continue to apply. The 10 new commercial models and 55 test models are scheduled for release in March 2027.

translationZh:
瑞士制造商Ecorobotix正在扩展其ARA精准喷雾器，从2027年3月起新增10个商业作物检测模型，包括马铃薯、大蒜和韭菜。另有55个模型将开放免费测试，其中包括一个针对香附子的模型。据Ecorobotix称，新商业化模型的田间试验实现了相比广播喷雾平均减少86%的喷施投入。

这些新增使Ecorobotix的产品组合达到120多个植物识别和处理模型。该制造商表示，进入商业使用的模型在2026年期间于20多个国家超过11,000公顷（27,180英亩）的土地上进行了测试。报告的86%投入减少是这些试验的平均值。Ecorobotix尚未公布每个作物模型的单独结果。

**香附子检测正在开发中**

最引人注目的新增之一是针对香附子（Cyperus esculentus）的检测模型，这是一种通过地下块茎传播、特别难以控制的入侵杂草。

据Ecorobotix称，新算法可以在作物植株中识别香附子，并用非选择性除草剂对其进行靶向处理，而不会伤害周围作物。Ecorobotix农艺师兼作物算法产品经理Simon Gasser表示：“通过开发这一新算法，我们提供了首个能够检测香附子并将非选择性除草剂直接施用于杂草而不伤害作物的精准喷雾解决方案。”该模型将于2027年3月向ARA用户开放免费测试。其在不同田间条件下的有效性和作物选择性尚待已发表的对比结果来证明。

**马铃薯模型将于2027年商业化上市**

Ecorobotix还推出了马铃薯的商业检测模型。在开发过程中，该公司在瑞士田间试验中比较了使用ARA与常规广播喷雾的除草效果。据制造商称，该系统成功控制了马铃薯中的常见杂草，结果在施药后20天评估。公告中未包含详细的对比效果数据。比利时马铃薯种植户Luc Détroz reportedly在300公顷（741英亩）土地上使用了该模型。Détroz说：“这显然挽救了作物。一次作业中，我们就能控制藜和蓼，田块直到最后都保持无草状态。”

**超过1,000台ARA喷雾器在使用中**

Ecorobotix报告称，目前全球有超过1,000台ARA喷雾器在运行，累计处理面积超过600,000公顷（148万英亩）。该制造商还报告称，由于种植户在二甲戊灵受限后寻求替代方案，其现有胡萝卜模型的处理面积增加了80%以上。对种植户而言，不断扩展的软件组合可能使现有ARA喷雾器无需购买新机器即可适用于更多作物和杂草种类。然而，检测模型的可用性并不自动允许使用每种除草剂。当地产品授权和使用限制仍然适用。10个新商业模型和55个测试模型计划于2027年3月发布。
author: Geert Hekkert
